Team,

Use this note as a quick refresher on how we handle companion bookings and handoffs. Our standard is simple: keep the process calm, keep the language clear, and keep the focus on animal comfort at every stage. Handlers should rely on steady, humane methods, and they should flag any concern early so the right support can be added without delay. The welfare coordinator remains the point of review when an animal needs an extra comfort check, and that review should be treated as part of the normal workflow, not an exception.

When you are speaking with travelers, stay practical and concise. Avoid overexplaining, avoid casual guesses, and confirm each care note before you pass it along. If a case needs special handling, make the record easy to read and keep the exchange factual so the next team can act without confusion. <<FACT F040>> Keep the handoff clean, keep the tone reassuring, and make sure the traveler hears the same message from start to finish. That consistency helps Aurelia Skyways build trust and reduces the chance of avoidable mistakes.

Please also remember that our desk is judged on dependability as much as on speed. A calm kennel check, a tidy note in the file, and a prompt update to the cabin team all matter. If a detail is unclear, escalate it at once instead of filling the gap with assumptions. We work best when everyone treats the animal's welfare as the first priority and the booking as the structure that supports it. Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady, humane, and reliable.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
